from PIL import Image

img = Image.open\("/Users/doga.budak/Documents/piarcha/auto-battler/public/2026_premier.png"\)
w, h = img.size
print\(f"Image size: {w}x{h}"\)

cols, rows = 5, 4
cell_w = w / cols
cell_h = h / rows
print\(f"Cell size: {cell_w:.1f}x{cell_h:.1f}"\)

teams = [
    "arsenal", "aston_villa", "bournemouth", "brentford", "brighton",
    "chelsea", "crystal_palace", "everton", "fulham", "ipswich",
    "leicester", "liverpool", "man_city", "man_united", "newcastle",
    "nott_forest", "southampton", "tottenham", "west_ham", "wolves",
]

out_dir = "/Users/doga.budak/Documents/piarcha/auto-battler/public/crests"

for i, name in enumerate\(teams\):
    col = i % cols
    row = i // cols
    left = int\(col * cell_w\)
    top = int\(row * cell_h\)
    right = int\(\(col + 1\) * cell_w\)
    bottom = int\(\(row + 1\) * cell_h\)
    
    cell = img.crop\(\(left, top, right, bottom\)\)
    
    # Trim transparent padding to get just the crest
    bbox = cell.getbbox\(\)
    if bbox:
        cropped = cell.crop\(bbox\)
        # Resize to uniform 128x128 with padding to keep aspect ratio
        cropped.thumbnail\(\(128, 128\), Image.LANCZOS\)
        final = Image.new\("RGBA", \(128, 128\), \(0, 0, 0, 0\)\)
        paste_x = \(128 - cropped.width\) // 2
        paste_y = \(128 - cropped.height\) // 2
        final.paste\(cropped, \(paste_x, paste_y\)\)
        final.save\(f"{out_dir}/{name}.png"\)
        print\(f"  {name}.png  \(cropped {bbox} -> {cropped.size}\)"\)
    else:
        print\(f"  {name}.png  EMPTY CELL"\)

print\("Done!"\)
PYEOF)
